# Freesound CC0 sounds (D-061)

Put each downloaded file into the folder of its use (Saw, Drill, Hammer, Sanding, Wind, Waves, Yard), keeping
Freesound's file name (it starts with the sound's number, e.g. `383725__...wav`): the number gives its page, author and
licence for CREDITS.md. Only sounds marked "Creative Commons 0" on their page belong here. Claude converts them to Ogg
and trims long recordings (keeps the repository small).
